human_notes._source: guide (1 transcribed showcase, heavily auto-translated - mechanics trusted, names re-derived from the jar) + jar loot tables
how_to_fight: entity:mowziesmobs:foliaath only strikes at close range, so the guide's advice is to kill it with a RANGED weapon and never walk into it
entity:mowziesmobs:ferrous_wroughtnaut has a recovery window: block or dodge its axe swing, then attack while the axe is still travelling. It cannot be out-traded head-on

entity:mowziesmobs:frostmaw is asleep until approached, and the guide's key trick is that you can STEAL the mowziesmobs:ice_crystal from the sleeping boss first — without its crystal it loses its ice attacks and the fight becomes much easier
entity:mowziesmobs:umvuthi heals itself by summoning Umvuthana followers every time it loses about 40 HP; you must clear the summons before damaging the boss again or the fight never ends
entity:mowziesmobs:grottol flees instantly and is best taken with a bow, or captured (mowziesmobs:captured_grottol) rather than fought
diplomacy: Wearing an Umvuthana mask makes the Umvuthana village NON-hostile — a peaceful route the quest book can use instead of a kill task

The masks are mowziesmobs:umvuthana_mask_bliss, :umvuthana_mask_faith, :umvuthana_mask_fear, :umvuthana_mask_fury, :umvuthana_mask_misery, :umvuthana_mask_rage; each grants 1 armour plus a different buff
The truce breaks if you attack an Umvuthana, break blocks, or loot inside their village
boss_order: entity:mowziesmobs:foliaath — jungle ambush mob, earliest threat
entity:mowziesmobs:ferrous_wroughtnaut — first true boss, in its own underground chamber
entity:mowziesmobs:frostmaw — snowy boss, must be woken
entity:mowziesmobs:umvuthi — Sunbird, endgame boss of the Umvuthana camp
prep: Ferrous Wroughtnaut is a fixed-arena fight — it does not roam, so it is safe to gate a quest on finding the chamber
Frostmaw is asleep until provoked, which makes it the one boss a player can choose the timing of
order: entity:mowziesmobs:grottol drops plain diamonds and is the low-risk early target
Wroughtnaut -> its axe and helm -> Frostmaw -> Umvuthi
key_drops: mowziesmobs:sculptor_staff (Geomancer Staff) plus the geomancer set (mowziesmobs:geomancer_robe, :geomancer_belt, :geomancer_beads, :geomancer_sandals) — Sculptor
mowziesmobs:naga_fang — Naga; feeds mowziesmobs:naga_fang_dagger and the mowziesmobs:blowgun / mowziesmobs:dart line
mowziesmobs:foliaath_seed — Foliaath; the guide grows a tame Foliaath by feeding it meat
mowziesmobs:sol_visage is the real prize of the mod: 2 armour plus the Sun's Blessing ability set (Sun Strike, Solar Flare, Solar Beam, Supernova), recharged for free back at the Umvuthana temple
mowziesmobs:wrought_helmet gives 2 armour and 1 knockback resistance; mowziesmobs:wrought_axe is 'Axe of a Thousand Metals'
traps: mowziesmobs:umvuthana_follower_player and mowziesmobs:umvuthana_crane_player are registered and named but are player-summoned allies — no spawn egg, no loot table, no kill advancement. A kill task on them is uncompletable
The spawn egg is called wroughtnaut_spawn_egg but the ENTITY is mowziesmobs:ferrous_wroughtnaut — do not derive the entity id from the egg name
mowziesmobs:umvuthana_fury/_rage/_bliss/_faith/_fear/_misery are loot-table variants, not entity types
